पैशाच a. (ची f.) [पिशाचेन निर्वृत्तः
अण्] Demoniacal, infernal.
--चः
1
The eighth or lowest of the eight
forms of marriage in Hindu law, in
which a lover ravishes a maiden
without her consent when she is
sleeping, or intoxicated, or
deranged in intellect; सुप्तां मत्तां प्रमत्तां वा
रहो यत्रोपगच्छति । स पापिष्ठो विवाहानां
पैशाचश्चाष्टमोऽधमः

.
--2 A kind of demon or पिशाच.
--ची
1 A present made at a
religious ceremony.
--2 Night.
--3 A sort
of gibberish spoken on the stage
by demons, one of the lowest forms
of Prākṛta.

पैशुनं --न्यं [पिशुनस्य भावः अण् ष्यञ्
वा]
1 Back-biting, slandering,
talebearing, calumny;

पैष्ट a. (ष्टी f.) [पिष्टस्येदं अण्]
Made of flour or meal.

पैष्टिक a. (की f.) Made of flour
or meal.
--कं
1 A number of cakes.
--2 A spirituous liquor distilled
from meal.

पैष्टी A spirituous liquor distilled
from meal; cf. गौडी.
